title: Welcome to SplatGPT
text: The logo takes you home to your dashboard, where widgets live. Use Next or Skip any time.

title: Chats
text: Every conversation in one place. Hit New chat there to start a fresh one; chats save automatically in this browser.

title: Live
text: Rotations, the latest Top 500, and Salmon Run shifts — each on its own tab, no chat needed.

title: Goals
text: Set X Power, rank, or custom grind goals — tracked with live board data, pace estimates, and streaks.

title: Settings
text: Themes, navigation style (sidebar or a floating pill on any edge), the build fetcher, your player card, what I know about you, and the About page.

title: Game datasets
text: Switch the local dataset between Splatoon 1, 2, and 3. Rankings and rotations always reflect Splatoon 3.

title: Ask anything
text: Try “current X rotation”, “who is #247?”, “best build for Splattershot”, or “what does Ninja Squid do?”.

title: Shortcuts
text: One-tap prompts for the most common lookups. That's the tour — good luck out there.
